Answer ID: 15034 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1234/252=TL/1430) It is unlawful to perform only one rak?ah witr, the Propjet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) prohibited performing single rak?ah.
